data.title: MySQL logical plugin-route acceptance harness
data.description: Review bn-2mf2: replace five legacy generic database endpoints with exact database:3306=mysql:// logical plugin-route bindings in Sigil compatibility and live acceptance. Exact Sigil 0.34.0-rc.1 just sigil-check and separate just check passed.

data.reason: LGTM — reviewed exact 6f20f84..15d30dc range and all five route replacements. Each binding exactly matches the reviewed grant target database:3306 while mapping only to a loopback mysql:// published socket; Sigil's parser validates canonical target, credential-free bare URL, explicit numeric port, and resolves the route fail-closed before scenario execution. Shell values remain quoted and originate from numeric-only published/mock ports. No command injection, secret widening, HTTP authority widening, or error-handling regression.
